admission_decision: ADMITTED (partial — M3a supported, M3b real null; no implementation bugs)

findings.description: heldout_probe chains (40) non-overlapping with main/calib/donor; chain-level 8:1:1 split prevents residue-level leakage

M3a: 40 chains used vs 250 planned; test set = 4 chains (~736 residues). Plan flagged as suspected_under_power. However bacc=1.0 with perm p<0.001 across all 4 blocks is strong evidence charge is trivially decodable. WARN retained for under-scale.
Multinomial LogisticRegression with balanced class weights; 1000-permutation null; AUROC macro reported. v_charge = L2-normalized (w_pos - w_neg). Implementation correct.
M3a predicates: bacc=1.0 (≥0.75 threshold, PASS); perm_p=0.000999 (<0.001, PASS)
β·σ_proj units correctly applied: σ_proj=21.55 from 50-chain calibration; α={-3,-1,0,+1,+3}×σ_proj; α=0 as explicit sweep point. Matches EXPERIMENT_TIPS.md steering-coefficient-tuning spec.
M3b: 179 ok records per condition × 5 β × 2 configs + controls. No missingness. Numerically clean null.

All 5 causal predicates fail: Spearman same=0.354, opp=0.040 (both <0.7); same_vs_opp Δ=0.006 (<0.15pp), p=1.0; matched_ctrl=99.4% ≈ target (not <50%). This is a scientifically real null — not an implementation bug.
Random-direction v_random control hairpin rate=100% confirms steering strength is insufficient to collapse hairpin — structural inertia, not direction specificity, is the limiting factor

note: C3 = M3a (PASS) + M3b (real null). Both parts methodologically complete. C3 as composite claim is partially supported. Phase 2 verdict PASS (WARN on scale) — claim is ADMITTED with partial supported/not-supported split.
